installer-gui-script.title: parsec

choice.title: parsec
choice.description: The parsec binary: /usr/local/parsec, a copy at ~/.parsec/bin/parsec, and a PATH line in your shell rc. Starts the local proxy. Required.

choice.title: Claude Code
choice.description: Installs the parsec plugin (status line, hooks, skills) through the claude CLI and points ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL in ~/.claude/settings.json at the local proxy. Undo: parsec disable · claude plugin uninstall parsec@parsec-marketplace.

choice.title: Codex CLI
choice.description: Routes Codex through the local proxy (ChatGPT-subscription mode). For an OPENAI_API_KEY provider instead, run parsec setup codex --byok afterwards. Undo: parsec disable codex.

choice.title: opencode
choice.description: Installs the parsec plugin shim for opencode (Anthropic API-key providers). Undo: parsec disable opencode.

choice.title: pi
choice.description: Points pi's built-in anthropic provider at the local proxy (your existing OAuth or API-key auth keeps working; other providers go direct) and installs the parsec extension in pi's agent directory. Undo: parsec disable pi.

choice.title: Claude Desktop
choice.description: Process-scoped TLS interception of Cowork / Agent mode. Installs mitmproxy (Homebrew), trusts its CA in the System keychain (done with the password you already entered), and registers the interceptor to start at login. macOS then needs one toggle from you, which the menu-bar app waits for. Undo: parsec disable desktop.

choice.title: Menu-bar app
choice.description: Live proxy / Desktop / savings status in the menu bar, and the guided completion of the Claude Desktop approval. Starts at login. Undo: parsec tray uninstall.

choice.title: Sign in
choice.description: Opens https://app.getparsec.ai in your browser to hand this machine its dashboard key.
